{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Style spec update

on:
  schedule:
    # Monday 06:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-style-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      # Cache the Dart package cache so `melos bootstrap` and `dart run`
      # reuse previously fetched dependencies instead of re-downloading them
      # on every weekly run.
      - name: Cache Dart pub cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.pub-cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pub-${{ hashFiles('**/pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pub-

      - uses: bluefireteam/melos-action@v3
        with:
          run-bootstrap: true

      # Captured before updating: reports pinned vs latest, per platform.
      - name: Report upstream drift
        id: report
        working-directory: scripts
        run: |
          dart run lib/check_style_spec.dart --latest | tee /tmp/style-spec-report.txt || true
          {
            echo 'report<<REPORT_EOF'
            cat /tmp/style-spec-report.txt
            echo 'REPORT_EOF'
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          # The report already resolved the latest version; pass it on so the
          # update step does not ask the registry again, and so the two steps
          # cannot disagree if upstream publishes in between.
          sed -n 's/^latest=/latest=/p' /tmp/style-spec-report.txt >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Update to the latest release
        working-directory: scripts
        run: |
          version='${{ steps.report.outputs.latest }}'
          if [ -n "$version" ]; then
            dart run lib/check_style_spec.dart --update="$version"
          else
            dart run lib/check_style_spec.dart --update
          fi

      - name: Regenerate code
        run: melos run generate

      - name: Read pinned version
        id: version
        run: echo "version=$(cat scripts/input/style_spec_version.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # No-op when the working tree is unchanged (already on the latest
      # release). Reuses one branch, so weekly runs update the same PR
      # instead of stacking new ones.
      - name: Open or update the pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          branch: chore/update-style-spec
          delete-branch: true
          commit-message: "chore: update MapLibre style spec to ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          title: "chore: update MapLibre style spec to ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          body: |
            Automated weekly update of `scripts/input/style.json` to
            `@maplibre/maplibre-gl-style-spec@${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}`,
            with the code regenerated from it (`melos run generate`).

            Drift report at the time of the run:

            ```
            ${{ steps.report.outputs.report }}
            ```

            Before merging:
            - [ ] Check the generated diff for new properties that deserve a CHANGELOG entry.
            - [ ] Properties listed as web-only above are expected to be absent from the Java/Swift converters.",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly fetches Dart dependencies on every weekly run (melos bootstrap runs pub get, and dart run resolves packages). The Flutter SDK is already cached via subosito/flutter-action with cache: true, but the Dart pub cache (~/.pub-cache) is not. Adding actions/cache for the pub cache, keyed on the runner OS and pubspec.lock files, reuses previously fetched dependencies across runs while preserving every build and test step. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency cache), whose preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs and cache inputs include the lockfile and environment. No permissions are weakened, no privileged actions or new network access is added, and all original steps and coverage are retained.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
